recipe: Fixed interval; fake read-only gh REST API returns two pages. No stdout/stderr normalization. Each case runs in an isolated temporary directory with only gh shim prepended to PATH. API log calls are recorded in order.
gh_shim:
import json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
api = json.loads(Path(os.environ['SLO_API']).read_text())
assert sys.argv[1:3] == ['api', '--allow-escape-sequences'], sys.argv
path = sys.argv[3]
if api.get('error'):
    sys.stderr.write(api['error']); sys.exit(1)
if '/logs' in path:
    assert len(sys.argv) == 4
    job = path.split('/jobs/')[1].split('/')[0]
    with open(os.environ['SLO_CALLS'], 'a') as calls: calls.write(job + '\n')
    entry = api['logs'].get(job, '')
    if isinstance(entry, dict): sys.exit(entry['exit_code'])
    sys.stdout.write(entry)
else:
    assert sys.argv[4:] == ['--paginate', '--slurp'], sys.argv
    if '/workflows/fleet.yml/runs' in path:
        key, data = 'workflow_runs', api['runs']
    else:
        key, data = 'jobs', api['jobs'][path.split('/runs/')[1].split('/')[0]]
    print(json.dumps([{key: data[:1]}, {key: data[1:]}]))
